harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Converted the two Latin-1 filenames to UTF-8 under converted/. The existing plain.txt collision was preserved and documented in /srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration/collision-report.txt. Source files remain unchanged, and all results survived a node restart.
actions_performed: Converted café.txt and résumé.txt while retaining their contents and relative structure.
Preserved the existing converted/plain.txt without overwrite.
Recorded the plain.txt collision in collision-report.txt.
Verified all source and destination files using byte comparisons and SHA-256 hashes.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed the boot identity changed, the system recovered with zero failed units, and all data persisted.

evidence.requirement: Inspect source encoding, inventory, source tree, and existing destinations
evidence.summary: Confirmed ISO-8859-1 filename bytes, three source files, and a pre-existing converted/plain.txt with different content.

evidence.requirement: Convert Latin-1 filenames to UTF-8 while preserving structure and contents
evidence.summary: Copied café.txt and résumé.txt; direct cmp and SHA-256 verification proved their contents match the source files.

evidence.requirement: Preserve imported tree and handle collisions without overwrite or silent loss
evidence.summary: All three original source hashes remained unchanged. converted/plain.txt retained its original hash, and collision-report.txt explicitly records the skipped source.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID and healthy data were captured; the safe reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed from 6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72 to c391417f-8a4e-48a1-ae7a-bfbd69a73e90; afterward the system was running with zero failed units and all conversion, source, and collision evidence remained valid.
